headline: Public hearing on sale of Centre Square Parcels 30 and 30-3 drew no speakers.
summary: A public hearing was held on the proposed sale of Centre Square Parcel 30 and Parcel 30-3. No one appeared to speak at the hearing. The hearing was then closed, with all members present voting in favor.
